# Assumptions

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_assumptions.py from the engine; do not edit by hand. -->

Every number ArchSim 0.13.0 uses without you typing it, and where it comes from:

- **documented**: the vendor's documentation states it (linked);
- **illustrative**: a typical value ArchSim chose, not a vendor guarantee and not a measurement. Replace it with your own numbers before trusting absolute results.

Generated from the code that uses these values (`uv run python scripts/gen_assumptions.py`); a test fails when this file is out of date.

## Technology tiers

**Core** technologies are the ones ArchSim focuses on and will validate against measurements first. **Experimental** ones stay available, with a badge in the parts library, the inspector, reports and exports that says: "Behaviour based on documentation and illustrative numbers; not yet validated against measurements." The generic part of each kind is core: it adds no technology behaviour, only the shared mechanisms (workers, connections, queues, service times) that the core technologies use too. No technology has been validated against measurements yet.

| Part | Core | Experimental |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Load Balancer | `nginx`, `aws_alb`, `generic` | `envoy`, `api_gateway`, `kong`, `haproxy`, `traefik` |
| Service / API Servers | `nodejs`, `java`, `go`, `generic` | `dotnet`, `rust`, `python`, `php`, `ruby` |
| Cache | `redis`, `generic` | `valkey`, `memcached`, `cdn`, `varnish` |
| Database | `postgresql`, `generic` | `mysql`, `mariadb`, `oracle`, `sqlserver`, `cockroachdb`, `yugabytedb`, `mongodb`, `couchbase`, `cassandra`, `scylladb`, `dynamodb`, `elasticsearch`, `opensearch` |
| Message Queue / Stream | `kafka`, `sqs`, `generic` | `rabbitmq`, `pubsub`, `nats`, `redis_streams` |
| Kubernetes cluster | `kubernetes` | `eks`, `gke`, `aks`, `k3s`, `openshift` |

## Engine constants

Numbers built into the sizing, cost and component models. Design review thresholds (for example 80% CPU at the peak) are rules of thumb stated with each finding, not inputs to the simulation.

| Area | Constant | Value | Basis | Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Auto-sizing | CPU utilisation a part is sized for at its peak | 60% | illustrative | `sizing.TARGET_CPU` |
| Auto-sizing | Memory headroom over what the model needs | +25% | illustrative | `sizing.MEMORY_HEADROOM` |
| Auto-sizing | Storage kept under this fill level | 70% | illustrative | `sizing.STORAGE_FILL` |
| Auto-sizing | Smallest auto storage | 10 GiB | illustrative | `sizing.MIN_STORAGE_GIB` |
| Auto-sizing | Largest auto memory of one service replica | 64 GiB | illustrative | `sizing.MAX_SERVICE_MEMORY_GIB` |
| Auto-sizing | Load balancer throughput per vCPU | 5,000 req/s | illustrative | `sizing.PROXY_RPS_PER_VCPU` |
| Auto-sizing | Load balancer memory per vCPU | 1 GiB | illustrative | `sizing.PROXY_GIB_PER_VCPU` |
| Auto-sizing | Broker throughput per vCPU | 10,000 messages/s | illustrative | `sizing.BROKER_MSGS_PER_VCPU` |
| Auto-sizing | Broker memory per vCPU | 2 GiB | illustrative | `sizing.BROKER_GIB_PER_VCPU` |
| Auto-sizing | Share of a database's data read often, when no hot working set is set | 25% | illustrative | `sizing.DB_HOT_SHARE` |
